title: Cost Basis and Lot Relief - DemoCo BTC Q1 2025
conclusionSummary: DemoCo elects FIFO lot relief applied wallet by wallet. The 190,000 USD of unused basis on 4 BTC held at 2025-01-01 (all acquired in 2024) is allocated across the two wallets under the Rev. Proc. 2024-28 specific unit allocation recorded on 2024-12-20; the 2.5 BTC disposal on 2025-03-20 then relieves lots L1 and half of L2 for 105,000 USD of basis and a 57,500 USD realized gain.
